experiment.name: student_architecture_reduction_importance_guided_v2
experiment.design_note: Importance-guided depth candidates use an empirical single-layer physical deletion scan. Uniform-drop controls are retained because single-layer rankings are not assumed additive.

pilot.name: depth_drop_1_importance
pilot.description: Remove the least damaging layer according to the student single-layer deletion scan.

pilot.name: depth_drop_1_uniform_control
pilot.description: Uniform single-layer deletion control matched for parameter count.

pilot.name: mlp_prune_10
pilot.description: Slice the lowest-activation 10 percent of gated-MLP channels in every layer.

pilot.name: combined_importance_light
pilot.description: Importance-guided one-layer deletion plus 5 percent hidden and 10 percent MLP width reduction.

full.name: depth_drop_1_importance
full.description: Remove the least damaging layer from the empirical single-layer scan.

full.name: depth_drop_2_importance
full.description: Remove the two best-ranked single-layer deletion candidates; full candidate evaluation checks interaction effects.

full.name: hidden_prune_10
full.description: Slice 10 percent of residual hidden coordinates.

full.name: hidden_prune_20
full.description: Slice 20 percent of residual hidden coordinates.

full.name: attention_groups_25
full.description: Remove one quarter of grouped-query attention KV groups where topology permits.

full.name: combined_importance_balanced
full.description: Importance-guided layer deletion with 10 percent hidden, 20 percent MLP, and 25 percent attention-group reduction.

full.name: combined_uniform_control
full.description: Matched combined control using uniform rather than sensitivity-ranked depth deletion.

full.name: combined_intermediate_target
full.description: Target the 180M-300M intermediate-teacher band using importance-guided depth reduction plus coordinated width/GQA reduction.

full.name: combined_small_target
full.description: Target the 100M-180M small-student band with two importance-ranked layers removed and coordinated 35 percent width reduction.

full.name: combined_deployment_target
full.description: Aggressive 80M-120M deployment-band experiment using four importance-ranked layers plus 50 percent hidden/MLP/GQA reduction; validly allowed to fail.
